0022600186.text: The Clippers, now 1-6 (1-2 at home, 0-4 on the road) and on a six-game losing streak, host the Miami Heat in their eighth game of the 2026-27 season, sitting 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 4.5 games back. Miami is 2-5, 10th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back, and has lost its last game. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Clippers lost both 2025-26 meetings 0-2, most recently 140-123 in Miami on December 1, 2025. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser, all listed as out, while Miami's Giannis Antetokounmpo and Myron Gardner are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
